honesty_clause: agent-judged; inter-pass disagreement = self-consistency floor, not human agreement
purpose: M2 blind answering passes (Q1–Q3): 80 convos x 3 candidates (b0/b1/b2) x 2 passes = 240 items/pass
renders_source: byte-identical to the `b0`/`b1`/`b2` fields of the pinned candidates.jsonl (see its meta for the render definitions)
rule: pass inputs carry ONLY item_id + codename + question + render (no convo_id, no candidate type, no flow/subflow/product — anti-leak, asserted mechanically); codenames are deterministic 6-hex digests with no structural relation to convo/candidate; pass2 uses a different seeded order than pass1; each pass runs in a FRESH agent context staged by stage (below) with no access to the other pass's answers; the transcript is NOT given to the answering judge (the scoring pass sees it, separately staged)
